title: Australian For AIs — Benchmark Example
description: Schema for a single benchmark example in the Australian For AIs dataset.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this example. Must not change after initial assignment.

utterance.description: The observed linguistic form of what was said.

context.description: Situational context required to interpret the utterance.

speaker_relationship.description: The social relationship between speaker and addressee.

literal_interpretation.description: The denotative, context-free semantic reading of the utterance.

pragmatic_interpretations.description: List of plausible socially intended readings. Must contain at least one entry.

primary_pragmatic_interpretation.description: The annotator's best-estimate pragmatic reading. Not claimed to be ground truth. May be 'insufficient_context' when context does not permit a determination.

humour_mechanisms.description: Taxonomy tags for pragmatic devices in use.

social_valence.description: The social register of this utterance in its given context.

hostility.description: Whether aggressive social intent is present. Not to be inferred from lexical content alone (AU-HUMOUR-001).

confidence.description: Annotator's confidence in the primary pragmatic interpretation (0.0–1.0).

ambiguity.description: True if multiple substantially different pragmatic interpretations are plausible.

cultural_dependency.description: Whether interpretation requires specific cultural knowledge.

context_required.description: Whether pragmatic interpretation is substantially context-dependent.

alternative_interpretations.description: Other plausible interpretations the annotator considered.

annotation_notes.description: Free-text documentation of annotation reasoning, uncertainty, or caveats.

provenance.description: Description of origin, licensing, and consent status. Must contain non-whitespace content.

license.description: Licence for this example. Must contain non-whitespace content.

context_swap_group.description: Optional. Links examples that share the same utterance but differ in context.
